intro: A New Plague is an introductory task in Brill that reveals the Forsaken's overarching strategic ambition. Apothecary Johaan tasks recruits with harvesting the blood of wild darkhounds to lay the groundwork for a virulent pathogen commissioned directly by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise. She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.
My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, friend Time is fleeting!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend and I thank you for your efforts.
